**Q1: Which part of this repo should change? (Multiple selections allowed.)**
Choices:
- **A** — The core issue-to-PR pipeline (`clarify`, `plan`, `implement`, `review_autofix`) (RECOMMENDED)
- **B** — The orchestrator / poller / validation / merge automation (`orchestrate*`, `validate`) (RECOMMENDED)
- **C** — Docs, prompts, or operator-facing text only
Reply: `Q1: A+B`
**Q2: What exact request should planning anchor to?**
Choices:
- **A** — Fix a broken behavior; in your reply, include the exact primary workflow/script/file and one issue/PR/run number that reproduces it (RECOMMENDED)
- **B** — Improve a specific metric without changing behavior; in your reply, include the exact primary workflow/script/file and the metric to improve (`runtime`, `API calls`, `cost`, `notification noise`, etc.) (RECOMMENDED)
- **C** — Change docs/prompt/text only; in your reply, include the exact file/section and what should read differently
Reply: `Q2: A`
